title: Fenix Frames
description: Elite optimization and utility modpack for Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric. Reborn for speed.
body:
# 🐦‍🔥 Fenix Frames: Performance Reborn

**Fenix Frames** is a high-performance optimization modpack for **Minecraft 1.21.1 (Fabric)**. This pack is specifically designed to provide a smooth, high-FPS experience on all devices, including low-end PCs and Android tablets via PojavLauncher.

### ✨ Main Features:
* **Maximum FPS:** Includes Sodium, Lithium, and FerriteCore for top-tier optimization.
* **Full Controller Support:** Powered by Controlify, perfect for a console-like experience on tablets.
* **Stability:** Featuring ModernFix and ImmediatelyFast to ensure the best performance.
* **Shader Ready:** Includes Iris Shaders support for those who want better visuals without losing speed.

### 📜 Credits:
This modpack uses several community-made mods. All rights and credits belong to their respective authors on Modrinth.
